specification.description: Romantic yellow strappy heels with slim leather straps and a polished silhouette for work styling. Standard fit with a balanced mid-height heel.
construction_details: Adjustable leather ankle strap with fine buckle
Open toe with crossed forefoot straps
Wrapped block heel and durable rubber-tipped outsole
specification.care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft cloth and use a small amount of leather conditioner when needed. Store away from moisture and direct sunlight.
